GST Registration Guidelines (Illustrative Placeholder)
Goods and Services Tax (GST) registration is required for suppliers whose aggregate turnover exceeds the prescribed
Thresholds:
Goods suppliers: Rs 40 lakh (Rs 20 lakh for special category states).
Service providers: Rs 20 lakh (Rs 10 lakh for special category states).
Inter-state supply and e-commerce operators: registration required irrespective of threshold.
Requirements:
PAN of the applicant.
Aadhaar number.
Proof of business registration / incorporation.
Address proof and bank account details.
Digital signature (DSC) for companies and LLPs.
Official portal: https://www.gst.gov.in/ (placeholder - verify on official site)

MSME Support Schemes (Illustrative Placeholder)
This is a PLACEHOLDER document listing illustrative MSME schemes pending collection from https://www.myscheme
Illustrative schemes:
- Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE): collateral-free credit.
- Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP): subsidy for new micro enterprises.
- Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (CLCSS): technology upgradation subsidy.
Eligibility conditions vary by scheme and must be verified on the official scheme portal before application.
Official portals: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/, https://www.startupindia.gov.in/ (placeholder - verify on official site)

Aadhaar number of the proprietor/partner/director.
